newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Piltel, Globe in network pact.
newsitem.headline: Piltel, Globe in network pact.

text.p: Cellular phone company Pilipino Telephone Corp (Piltel) has signed an interconnection agreement with Globe Telecom that will link the communications' networks of the two companies.
In a joint statement to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on Thursday, the companies said the interconnection pact will allow subscribers of Piltel and Globe to directly access each other.
The agreement was signed by Piltel president Ramon Cojuangco and newly-appointed Globe Telecom chief executive officer Delfin Lazaro.
